newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's Cochilco raises 97 copper price forecast.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Cochilco raises 97 copper price forecast.

text.p: Chile's state copper studies center Comision Chilena del Cobre said it has raised its copper price forecast to an average $1.05-$1.10 a pound from its previous estimate of $1.00-$1.05

"As a result of the situation observed in the market, the Comision Chilena del Cobre (Cochilco) has changed its earlier forecast of 100-105 cents a pound for a range of 105-100 cents a pound," said the statement.
The higher forecast is the result of a shortage of the red metal since March which has resulted in a sustained fall in stocks, especially in the LME, said the report from Cochilco.

The difference in stock levels in the LME and COMEX in recent months is the result of price differences between the two markets with metal moving from LME warehouses to those operated by COMEX, said Cochilco.
"The transfer...was the result of arbitrage operations buying copper in the market with the lower price and selling it in the market where prices were higher," said the report.
Copper prices have also been highly volatile in the last six months with the market showing signs of speculation, it said.
